title: denationalize — disarm

sentences.sentence: The government started to denationalize financial institutions.
sentences.translation: 政府开始将金融机构私有化。

phrases.translation: deny someone something 拒绝给予

sentences.sentence: The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
sentences.translation: 政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

sentences.sentence: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
sentences.translation: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

sentences.sentence: At least six people were killed and about twenty injured when a train was derailed in an isolated mountain region.
sentences.translation: 火车在一片偏僻的山区脱轨，导致至少六人死亡，约二十人受伤。

sentences.sentence: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
sentences.translation: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

sentences.sentence: He was a direct descendant of Napoleon Bonaparte.
sentences.translation: 他是拿破仑·波拿巴的嫡系后裔。

sentences.sentence: the descriptive passages in the novel
sentences.translation: 小说中的描写性段落

sentences.sentence: What have I done to deserve this?
sentences.translation: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

sentences.sentence: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
sentences.translation: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

sentences.sentence: Ledley deserves a place in the team.
sentences.translation: 莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。

sentences.sentence: Paula deserves a special mention for all the help she has given us.
sentences.translation: 应该特别提一下葆拉，她给了我们许多帮助。

sentences.sentence: I would never hit anyone, even if they deserved it.
sentences.translation: 我决不会打人，哪怕他欠揍。

sentences.sentence: What has he done to deserve this punishment ?
sentences.translation: 他做了什么，竟会受到这样的惩罚？

sentences.sentence: People who are sent to prison for drunk-driving get what they deserve .
sentences.translation: 那些醉酒驾车被送进监狱的人是罪有应得的。

sentences.sentence: I had no money left and was desperate.
sentences.translation: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

sentences.sentence: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
sentences.translation: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

sentences.sentence: the missing teenager’s desperate parents
sentences.translation: 失踪少年绝望的父母

phrases.translation: 旅游胜地；旅游目的地；旅游景点

sentences.sentence: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
sentences.translation: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

phrases.translation: 相消干涉，相消干扰；破坏性干扰

sentences.sentence: the destructive power of modern weapons
sentences.translation: 现代武器的破坏力

phrases.translation: 独立式住宅；独立式房子

sentences.sentence: Try to take a more detached view .
sentences.translation: 尽量采取更为客观的态度。

sentences.sentence: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
sentences.translation: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

sentences.sentence: She hired a detective to find out if her husband was having an affair.
sentences.translation: 她雇了一个私人侦探调查她丈夫是否有外遇。

sentences.sentence: Genius is nothing but labor and diligence.
sentences.translation: 天才无非是工作和勤奋。

sentences.sentence: We should cultivate the good habits of diligence and frugality.
sentences.translation: 我们要养成勤俭节约的好风气。

sentences.sentence: in the dim light of the early dawn
sentences.translation: 在微弱的晨曦里

sentences.sentence: a dim glow
sentences.translation: 昏暗的微光

sentences.sentence: The party’s share of the electorate has diminished steadily.
sentences.translation: 支持这个政党的选民比例持续下降。

sentences.sentence: These drugs diminish blood flow to the brain.
sentences.translation: 这些药物会减少流向脑部的血液量。

sentences.sentence: Criminal behaviour can be linked to economic disadvantage.
sentences.translation: 犯罪行为可能会与经济困难有关。

sentences.sentence: At this point the path seemed to disappear altogether (= disappear completely ) .
sentences.translation: 小路到这里好像完全消失了。

sentences.sentence: Getting the rebels to disarm will not be easy.
sentences.translation: 要让叛乱分子解除武装并非易事。

text:
英语词汇 · 六级 · 第 11 单元

denationalize
音标：英 /ˌdi:'næʃnəlaɪz/  美 /,di'næʃnəlaɪz/
v. 使非国有化
例句：The government started to denationalize financial institutions.
政府开始将金融机构私有化。

deny
音标：英 /dɪ'naɪ/  美 /dɪ'nai/
v. 否认
短语：deny oneself — 节制；戒除
短语：deny something to someone — deny someone something 拒绝给予
短语：deny access — 拒绝访问；不让进入
例句：The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

deprive
音标：英 /dɪ'praɪv/  美 /dɪ'praɪv/
v. 剥夺
短语：deprive of — vt. 剥夺；失去
例句：They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

derail
音标：英 /dɪ'reɪl/  美 /dɪ'rel/
v. 脱轨
例句：At least six people were killed and about twenty injured when a train was derailed in an isolated mountain region.
火车在一片偏僻的山区脱轨，导致至少六人死亡，约二十人受伤。

derive
音标：英 /dɪ'raɪv/  美 /dɪ'raɪv/
v. 获得
短语：derive from — 源出，来自，得自；衍生于
例句：Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

descendant
音标：英 /dɪˈsendənt/  美 /dɪ'sɛndənt/
n. 子孙后代
例句：He was a direct descendant of Napoleon Bonaparte.
他是拿破仑·波拿巴的嫡系后裔。

descriptive
音标：英 /dɪˈskrɪptɪv/  美 /dɪ'skrɪptɪv/
adj. 描写的，描述的
短语：descriptive geometry — n. 画法几何学
短语：descriptive study — 描述性研究
短语：descriptive statistic — 描述性统计
短语：descriptive information — 叙述（性）情报
短语：descriptive prose — 描写性散文
短语：descriptive research — 描述性研究
例句：the descriptive passages in the novel
小说中的描写性段落

deserve
音标：英 /dɪ'zɜ:v/  美 /dɪ'zɝv/
v. 值得
例句：What have I done to deserve this?
我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？
例句：I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。
例句：Ledley deserves a place in the team.
莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。
例句：Paula deserves a special mention for all the help she has given us.
应该特别提一下葆拉，她给了我们许多帮助。
例句：I would never hit anyone, even if they deserved it.
我决不会打人，哪怕他欠揍。
例句：What has he done to deserve this punishment ?
他做了什么，竟会受到这样的惩罚？
例句：People who are sent to prison for drunk-driving get what they deserve .
那些醉酒驾车被送进监狱的人是罪有应得的。

desperate
音标：英 /ˈdespərət/  美 /'dɛspərət/
adj. 绝望的，不顾一切的
例句：I had no money left and was desperate.
我身无分文，已经走投无路了。
例句：Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。
例句：the missing teenager’s desperate parents
失踪少年绝望的父母

destination
音标：英 /ˌdestɪˈneɪʃn/  美 /,dɛstɪ'neʃən/
n. 目的地
短语：tourist destination — 旅游胜地；旅游目的地；旅游景点
短语：port of destination — 目的港
短语：final destination — 最终目的地
短语：destination port — 目的港；目的端口
短语：ultimate destination — 最终目的地
短语：destination airport — 目的地机场；到达机场
短语：destination node — 目的节点；目标节点
短语：country of destination — 目的国；收货地国家
短语：destination country — 前往目的地国；到达国
短语：destination address — 目标地址
短语：place of destination — 目的地
短语：destination folder — 目标文件夹
短语：destination directory — [计]目标目录，目的目录
短语：destination file — 目标文件；结果文件
例句：Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

destructive
音标：英 /dɪ'strʌktɪv/  美 /dɪ'strʌktɪv/
adj. 破坏性的，毁灭性的
短语：destructive power — 破坏力
短语：destructive testing — 破坏性试验
短语：destructive effect — 破坏性
短语：destructive test — 破坏性试验
短语：destructive interference — 相消干涉，相消干扰；破坏性干扰
短语：non destructive testing — 非破坏性检查
例句：the destructive power of modern weapons
现代武器的破坏力

detached
音标：英 /dɪˈtætʃt/  美 /dɪ'tætʃt/
adj. 冷漠的，超然的
短语：be detached from — 把…从…上卸下；脱离…
短语：detached house — 独立式住宅；独立式房子
短语：detached garage — n. 独立式车库
例句：Try to take a more detached view .
尽量采取更为客观的态度。

detect
音标：英 /dɪ'tekt/  美 /dɪ'tɛkt/
v. 发现
例句：Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

detective
音标：英 /dɪˈtektɪv/  美 /dɪ'tɛktɪv/
n. 侦探
短语：detective story — 侦探小说
短语：private detective — 私家侦探
短语：detective film — 侦探片
例句：She hired a detective to find out if her husband was having an affair.
她雇了一个私人侦探调查她丈夫是否有外遇。

diligence
音标：英 /ˈdɪlɪdʒəns/  美 /'dɪlɪdʒəns/
n. 勤奋
短语：due diligence — 尽职调查
例句：Genius is nothing but labor and diligence.
天才无非是工作和勤奋。
例句：We should cultivate the good habits of diligence and frugality.
我们要养成勤俭节约的好风气。

dim
音标：英 /dɪm/  美 /dɪm/
adj. 暗淡的；愚蠢的
短语：dim sum — （汉）点心
短语：dim light — 微光；弱光；暗光灯
例句：in the dim light of the early dawn
在微弱的晨曦里
例句：a dim glow
昏暗的微光

diminish
音标：英 /dɪ'mɪnɪʃ/  美 /dɪ'mɪnɪʃ/
v. 减少
短语：diminish inflammation — 消炎
例句：The party’s share of the electorate has diminished steadily.
支持这个政党的选民比例持续下降。
例句：These drugs diminish blood flow to the brain.
这些药物会减少流向脑部的血液量。

disadvantage
音标：英 /ˌdɪsəd'vɑ:ntɪdʒ/  美 /,dɪsəd'væntɪdʒ/
n. 缺点，不利条件
短语：at a disadvantage — 处于不利地位
短语：to the disadvantage of — adv. 对…不利
短语：disadvantage factor — 不利因素；不利因子
例句：Criminal behaviour can be linked to economic disadvantage.
犯罪行为可能会与经济困难有关。

disappear
音标：英 /ˌdɪsə'pɪə(r)/  美 /'dɪsə'pɪr/
v. 消失
短语：disappear from — 从…处消失
例句：At this point the path seemed to disappear altogether (= disappear completely ) .
小路到这里好像完全消失了。

disarm
音标：英 /dɪs'ɑ:m/  美 /dɪs'ɑrm/
v. 解除，消除
例句：Getting the rebels to disarm will not be easy.
要让叛乱分子解除武装并非易事。
